subject: Marketplace localization + billing adapter: co-sell integration sync
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@gearbox.ai>; CloudOps Partner Ops <partners@cloudops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace localization + billing adapter: co-sell integration sync

Hi Amit / CloudOps team,

Great to see the traction from the pilot. Quick sync ask: Gearbox requested a localized listing (US/CA) and wants co-sell entitlements to flow to their reseller; that requires we map SKU billing events across AWS/Azure/GCP and validate the PrivateOffer/Resell paths. Can we do a 30-min technical sync this week to confirm the billing adapter contract points (metering event names, sku mapping, and org-level revenue split)?

Agenda I suggest:
- Short architecture overview (10m)
- SKU / meter mapping (10m)
- Co-sell entitlement & reporting (5m)
- Next steps / owners (5m)

I've looped in Ben for marketplace ops and Vivek for partnership approvals.

Attachments: SOW_Gearbox_v2.pdf (draft), billing-mapping-aws-azure-gcp.xlsx (starter)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
From: Amit Shah <amit@gearbox.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudOps Partner Ops <partners@cloudops.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace localization + billing adapter: co-sell integration sync

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the note. 30 min works for us on Thursday morning PT. We want to confirm two things up front:
1) Whether Redwood will surface a single combined metered event for co-sell reporting or if Gearbox needs per-cloud raw events (we currently consume both).
2) How refunds and credits are reconciled when usage is resold by a partner (we need the financial flow so our finance team can sign the SOW).

I'll bring our lead engineer (cc'd privately) and our finance contact to the call. Also reviewed the billing-mapping spreadsheet — will add our proposed AWS meter names by EOD.

Best,
Amit Shah
VP, Partnerships
Gearbox AI

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace localization + billing adapter: co-sell integration sync

Kim / Vivek — quick internal note before the sync with Gearbox:
- Ops constraints: for PrivateOffer flow on Azure we need the tenant alias from Gearbox; without it we can't map entitlement IDs into our telemetry exports.
- Billing mapping: our preferred approach is to emit a canonical tokenized meter (redwood.co_sell.unit) with labels for cloud and sku, then provide a translation table (we currently use this for a small set of resellers). This keeps analytics consistent across clouds.
- Finance: if Gearbox requires gross-to-gross resale (they recognize revenue on gross), legal needs a rev-share appendix. Monica, can you confirm whether the SOW draft includes a rev-share clause or if we should add one?

Ben
Director, Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@gearbox.ai>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, CloudOps Partner Ops <partners@cloudops.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jun 2028 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace localization + billing adapter: co-sell integration sync

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Thu 10:30am PT. Agenda updated and I've uploaded a revised SOW and a new co-sell RACI doc to the shared Drive. Key pre-read asks for Gearbox: please add your AWS meter names to the spreadsheet and confirm the reseller tenant alias for Azure.

Attached (stubs): co-sell-roles-RACI.docx (roles/owners), billing-mapping-aws-azure-gcp.xlsx (please update), SOW_Gearbox_v2.pdf (tracked changes).

If Gearbox requires gross rev recognition we will route to Legal for a rev-share appendix — Monica, ping me with the clause language and I'll ask Contracts to prepare a redline.

See you on the call.

Thanks,
Kim

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@gearbox.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace localization + billing adapter: co-sell integration sync

Short update after today's internal review and call:
- Legal okayed a standard reseller rev-share appendix template. Monica, please send the template and a checklist of any Gearbox-specific contract asks.
- Ops to implement canonical meter with cloud labels; Ben, coordinate with Engineering to create the translation webhook for Gearbox's ingestion endpoint.
- Product ask: add a flag to the marketplace listing metadata to indicate 'co-sell-enabled' + 'region-restrictions' so UI and API surfaces are consistent.

Amit — thanks for confirming your meter names in the sheet. Once Monica shares the Legal appendix we'll run a 48-hour contract turn and aim to publish the localized listings in the week after.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Global Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOW_Gearbox_v2.pdf, billing-mapping-aws-azure-gcp.xlsx, co-sell-roles-RACI.docx
